cases.question: How many paid holidays do we get each year?
cases.answer:
Northwind Robotics gives you **11 paid company holidays** a year (Holidays §1):

- New Year's Day
- Martin Luther King Jr. Day
- Presidents' Day
- Memorial Day
- Juneteenth
- Independence Day
- Labor Day
- Thanksgiving Day
- The day after Thanksgiving
- Christmas Eve
- Christmas Day

The exact dates for next year go up in the HR portal each December (Holidays §1).

You also get:
- **1 floating holiday** a year if you work full-time. It's meant for a religious, cultural or personal day that matters to you. You request it in the HR portal the same way you request PTO. If you don't use it by the end of the year, you lose it (Holidays §3).
- **Paid winter closure from December 26 to 31.** These days don't come out of your PTO. If your role has to be covered during the closure, your manager will schedule you and give you other days off in January (Holidays §5).

cases.question: How much PTO do I accrue each month?
cases.answer:
As a full-time employee, you earn **1.5 days of PTO a month**. It's added on the first day of each month, which comes to **18 days a year** (PTO §2.1). New hires start earning PTO in their first month.

You can see your available and pending days at any time in the HR portal (PTO §2.1). I can also look up your current balance if you'd like.

cases.question: Can I carry unused vacation days over into next year?
cases.answer:
Yes, but only up to 5 days:

- **Up to 5 unused PTO days** carry over into the next calendar year (PTO §2.2).
- If you have **more than 5 unused days on December 31**, you lose the extra days (PTO §2.2).
- Days you carry over **must be used by March 31** of the next year (PTO §2.2).

Some time off doesn't carry over at all:
- **Sick days** (PTO §4)
- **Your floating holiday**, which you have to use within the calendar year (Holidays §3)

I can also check how much PTO you have left so you can plan before year-end.

cases.question: Is there a stipend for setting up a home office?
cases.answer:
Yes. Full-time employees get a **one-time $500 home office stipend** for things like a desk, chair or monitor. You can use it once you've been here 30 days (Remote Work §3).

- **Internet:** The company also pays back up to **$50 a month** toward your home internet (Remote Work §3).
- **How to claim:** Submit both through the expense tool and tag them **"home office"** (Remote Work §3).
- **Equipment the company provides:** You get a laptop, plus a monitor and headset if you need them. This equipment belongs to the company and has to be returned when you leave (Remote Work §4).

cases.question: How long do I have to submit an expense after I pay for something?
cases.answer:
You have **30 days** from the date you paid to submit it through the expense tool. If you submit after 30 days, it may be declined (Expenses §2).

When you submit:
- Attach an itemized receipt for any single expense over $25 (Expenses §2).
- Add a short business purpose, for example "customer dinner, Acme site visit" (Expenses §2).

Purchases over $25 without a receipt won't be paid back (Expenses §5).

cases.question: When does my health insurance coverage start?
cases.answer:
Your health insurance starts on your first day of work. There's no waiting period (Benefits §1).

- **Cost:** The company pays 100% of your premium and 75% of the premium for any dependents (Benefits §1).
- **Deadline:** Your enrollment forms are due within 30 days of your start date (Benefits §1).

answers:
Yes, but only up to 5 days (PTO §2.2):

- **Up to 5 unused PTO days** carry over into the next calendar year.
- **Anything above 5 days** that's still unused on December 31 is lost.
- **Carried-over days must be used by March 31** of the next year.

Unused sick days don't carry over. Sick time is separate from PTO (PTO §4).
